Appreciate the intake form, looks good. Quick answers up front:

- Audit logs: we can provide object-level access logs (S3 access logs) and request/response traces for retrieval jobs for 90 days by default; we can extend retention for pilots.

Adding security context from Redwood's side.

Thanks for the intake, Sarah. A few clarifying points and constraints:
- External ingestion: we prefer short-lived STS credentials that are scoped to a single bucket/prefix and expire within 1 hour for ingestion jobs. We can also support presigned uploads where applicable.
- Audit evidence: we can export S3 access logs + per-request traces (token id, IP, request id). For SOC2 evidence sharing we normally provide a bundled export (csv + manifest) and a signed checksum.
- Pen-test scope: to avoid overlap with our platform tests, we ask partners to restrict pen-tests to the connector surface (auth, upload/download) and to run against a staging tenant with synthetic data.

I've attached our suggested pen-test scope template (pen-test-scope-v1.docx). Please review and let us know any additional checks GreyBox requires.

Availability: I can do a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow (May 5) 09:30–11:00 PDT.

-Hannah
